GROUND RULES: Contestants who choose to enter the Legacy Steer Roping event must be at least 50 years old or a permit member at the time of entry closing. They must also be entered in the steer roping event at the Wyoming State Fair & Rodeo. To be eligible, the contestant must not have been an NFSR qualifier during the past three years. Permit members of all ages will be eligible to enter.

Contestants will pay an additional entry fees of $200. Contestants will not compete on any additional steers. The times that are recorded for the contestants' competition runs at the Wyoming State Fair & Rodeo will be used to determine the pay-off. Pay-off will only include the entry fees for the contestants who entered the Legacy Steer Roping through PROCOM. 6% will be held out of the total amount for the PRCA prior to the pay-off. Only the first two go-rounds and the average after two go-rounds will be included in the pay-off for the Legacy Steer Roping (the progressive round will not be considered). There will be no additional added money and since no additional animals will be run, there will be no additional stock charge or PROCOM charge.

Money won in the Legacy Steer Roping will not count towards PRCA World Standings, circuit standings, All Around standings, or for money won qualifications. It will count towards qualifying for the Legacy Steer Roping Finals held in conjunction with the National Finals Steer Roping. (NFSR qualifiers will not be eligible for the Legacy Steer Roping Finals).
STK CONT.: Various

ALL CONTESTANTS - Re-entries will be accepted for available positions on Wed., Aug. 19 between 9 AM and 11 AM. See Rodeo Entry Information Section of the Business Journal.
GRACE PERIOD - Will expire one hour after entries close.

COMPETITION FORMAT: 24 minimum entries. No compensation. No slack. One go-round with a top 8 finals (plus splits, not to exceed 9. If ties result in more than 9 to advance to the finals, the contestant(s) with the highest ranking in the X-Broncs standings will advance).
QUALIFICATIONS: 24 entries. Based on 2026 X-Broncs Standings as of August 6, 2026. The alternate list for this event will be based on 2026 PRCA X-Broncs Standings as of August 6, 2026.

CHECK-IN - Contestants must check-in or notify arena secretary 1 hour prior to the start of the event. Failure to do so may result in an alternate contestant being selected and allowed to compete. The check-in deadline for alternates to be considered as "walk-up replacements" at Xtreme Broncs Events is 1 hour prior to start of the event.
STOCK DRAW - Stock will be drawn on site the night before by the judges. Horses will be placed in order on the judges sheets and the contestants will be drawn at random to the animals.

PAY-OFF: 6% of total purse is to be deducted prior to the pay-off and sent in with results. Of the remaining purse 30% of the total purse will be allocated to the long go-round, pays 8 places. 20% of the total purse will be allocated to the final go-round, pays 4 places, and 50% will be allocated to the average, pays 8 places. NOTE: If there is a tie for first place for the event championship, the tied contestants with the highest ranking in the X-Broncs standings will be the event winner (pay-off will be split). ALL PERCENTAGES WILL BE DIVIDED IN ACCORDANCE WITH RULEBOOK.

NOTE: If a contestant that is accepted as an entry at the Rapid City X-Broncs Finale is conflicted on the same day at another PRCA rodeo or event as the Rapid City X-Broncs Finale, he will be allowed to draw out of the conflicting rodeo or event as long as he notifies the draw out through PROCOM by Thursday, August 20 at 5 PM.

NOTE: Money won at this event will count towards qualifications for the 2026 National Finals Rodeo and the 2026 Rookie of the Year Standings, as long as the contestant has entered and competed in a minimum of forty (40) PRCA rodeos during the 2026 Rodeo Season. Money won will not count for circuit standings nor will it be applied to the contestants required circuit participation count. Money won at this event will not count towards All Around Standings.
STK CONT.: Various
SUB. CONT.: Burch Rodeo

The cutoff date is Mon., Aug. 24. Points for all Playoff Series rodeos that end prior to Aug. 24 will be included in qualifications for Puyallup.

BB, SB, BR, TD, SW, TR - 24 entries. The top 23 in each event based on 2026 Playoff Series Standings and the event winner of the NFR Open in each event who enter will be accepted as entries. If an event winner from the NFR Open does not enter or is already qualified based on Playoff Series Standings, the next highest ranked contestants from the NFR Open may be accepted (see complete ground rules for details and procedures.) The Champion header and the Champion heeler from the NFR Open will also be accepted. If the Champion header and/or the Champion heeler do not enter or is already qualified based on Playoff Series Standings, the next highest ranked header and/or heeler from the NFR Open may be accepted (see complete ground rules for details and procedures). Complete Ground Rules for the 2026 PRCA Playoff Series Finale can be found online at www.prorodeo.org.

FORMAT: ALL EVENTS - The Finale will be two go-rounds, back to back, performance to performance, with a top eight semi-finals followed by a top four finals. Contestants will be placed in the first four performances based on their pay-off series points standings. The following number rankings in the Playoff Series Standings will correspond with only the contestants who actually enter the Finale (for example, if the #1 ranked contestant does not enter and the #2 ranked contestant does enter, the #2 ranked contestant will assume the position as the #1 ranked contestant). If there is a tie for any of the rankings, a random draw by PROCOM will determine where each of the tied contestants will be placed. The #13 position in all events will be occupied by the qualifier from the NFR Open in Colorado Springs. The contestants placed in the first and second performances will be the contestants who correspond with the following rankings: #2, #3, #6, #7, #10, #11, #14, #15, #18, #19, #22, and #23. The contestants placed in the third and fourth performances will be the contestants who correspond with the following rankings: #1, #4, #5, #8, #9, #12, #13, #16, #17, #20, #21, and #24. The lowest ranked contestants (based on these rankings) will compete first, and the highest ranked contestants will compete last for the first go-round. The second go-round will be the reverse order of the first go-round. No trades will be allowed. In the Team Roping event, the 24 headers who qualify must rope with the 24 heelers who qualify. The 48 contestants who constitute the 24 teams will be ranked #1 through #48 based on Playoff Series points. The team will be placed in the position that corresponds with the highest ranked partner of the team using the same placement procedure as used for the other events. The #13 position in the Team Roping event will be occupied by the qualifying team from the NFR Open (or the highest ranked partner of the qualifying team from the NFR Open if the two team partners are roping with different qualified partners at this event). If a contestant's partner is drawn out due to qualification, that header or heeler will be randomly drawn a partner by PROCOM from among the other heelers or headers whose partners were drawn out due to qualification.

ALL EVENTS - Since the entry closing times for Puyallup and Sioux Falls occur after the entry closing time of other rodeos with dates that conflict with Puyallup and Sioux Falls, contestants who are placed in positions at other rodeos that conflict with their position at Puyallup or Sioux Falls will be allowed to draw out of the conflicting rodeo as long as they draw out through PROCOM by the turn out deadline of the conflicting rodeo.

ALL EVENTS - PROCOM will attempt to replace any contestant who notifies a turn-out, doctor's release or visible injury through PROCOM prior to the turn-out deadline for the first go-round of competition. The alternate list for replacements will be based on Playoff Series standings as August 24, 2026.
ENTRY FEES - BB, SB, BR, TD, SW AND TR will be $500 per contestant and will be paid by the PRCA.
COMPLETE CINCH PLAYOFF GROUND RULES can be found by clicking on the red link above.
STK CONT.: Calgary Stampede

detailLines: Pendleton OR NPP
September 14-15
Pendleton Extreme Bulls Tour Finale
ARENA: Happy Canyon Arena
ADDRESS: 1601 West Gate
PERFS: 2 Perfs: September 14- 8:00 PM; September 15- 8:00 PM
EVENTS: BR @ $150000
SPECIAL ENTRY FEES:
PERMITS: BR
GROUND RULES: ALL CONTESTANT - Re-entries will be accepted for available positions on Thurs., Sept. 10 between 9 AM and 11 AM. See Rodeo Entry Information page of the business journal.
GRACE PERIOD - Will expire one hour after entries close.

QUALIFICATIONS: 26 minimum entries. The top 20 contestants who enter based on 2026 X-bulls Standings as of September 6, 2026 will be accepted as entries. No exemptions. 6 will advance from the Wild Card round.

FORMAT: The first performance on Monday, Sept. 14 will include the Wild Card round followed by the first go-round of the X-bulls Finale. The second performance on Tuesday, Sept. 15 will include the second and third go-rounds of the X-bulls Finale. 22 entries will be accepted for the Wild Card Round which will include the 20 highest ranked contestants based on 2026 X-Bulls standings, who enter and who are not already accepted as entries among the top 20 for the X-Bulls Finale plus the first place winner of the Albuquerque X-Bulls event and the first place winner of the Lewiston X-Bulls event. If the winner of the Albuquerque and Lewiston events are already accepted as entries for the Wild Card round or the X-Bulls Finale due to qualifications, the next highest ranked contestant in the 2026 X-Bulls standings will be accepted for those positions (will not exceed 22). The top 6 based on highest scores in the Wild Card round will advance to the X-Bulls Finale for a total of 26 contestants in the Finale. If ties result in more than 6 to advance, the tied contestant(s) with the highest ranking in the X-Bulls Standings will advance. If there are less than 6 qualified rides in the Wild Card Round, any remaining positions to be filled in the X-Bulls Finale (not to exceed 26) will be based on 2026 X-Bulls Standings.
CHECK-IN - Contestants must check-in or notify arena secretary 1 hour prior to the start of the event. Failure to do so will result in an alternate contestant being selected and allowed to compete.

REPLACEMENTS: Contestants who turn out of the X-Bulls Finale (includes DR's and VIR's through Procom) may be replaced by contestants on the alternate list. There will be two alternate lists. The alternate list for the Wild Card Round will include the contestants who entered but were drawn out due to qualifications. The order of the Wild Card Alternate List will be based on ranking in the 2065 X-Bulls standings. The alternate list for the X-Bulls Finale will include the contestants who competed in the Wild Card Round who did not advance to the X-Bulls Finale. The order of X-Bulls Finale Alternate List will be based on rankings in the X-Bulls standings. Only contestants who turn out of the first go-round of the X-Bulls Finale will be replaced (includes DR's and VIR's through Procom). Contestants who turn out of the X-Bulls Finale will be replaced by a contestant who is already placed in the Wild Card Round. The alternate contestant who is being moved from his position in the Wild Card Round to the position in the X-Bulls Finale will be replaced by the first available alternate from the Wild Card Alternate List. If the contestant that notified the turn-out is not replaced by an alternate, he will be responsible for the $35 fee and the rodeo will count towards the official rodeo count. Any non-notified turn-out will be responsible for the $35 fee and the rodeo will count towards the official rodeo count, If a contestant properly doctor releases, he will not be responsible for entry fees nor will the event be applied to his official rodeo count. If a contestant turns out of this event after the stock draw and a replacement is not found, he will be charged a $500 turn out fine.

PAY-OFF: $12,000 of the total amount in the payoff will be allotted to the pay-off for the Wild Card Round. The Wild Card Round will pay six places. Percentages paid for places will be in accordance with the rulebook. Money won in the Wild Card Round will not count towards X-Bulls or Circuit Standings. Money won in the Wild Card Round will count towards World Standings and money won qualifications. The pay-off for the X-Bulls Finale will be in accordance with the PRCA Rule Book for three go-rounds and an average. The winner of the average of the X-Bulls Finale will be the be the Event winner. The highest ranked contestant based on X-Bulls Standings after the X-Bulls Finale will be the X-Bulls Champion.

NOTE - In order for money won at this event to count for the 2026 National Finals Rodeo or the 2026 Rookie of the Year Standings, during the 2026 season, a contestant must have entered and competed at a minimum of forty (40) PRCA rodeos during the 2026 rodeo year. Money won will count for PRCA World Standings and Xtreme Bulls Standings. It will not count for All Around standings, circuit standings, nor will the event be applied to a contestant's required circuit participation count. EF'S: No EF plus $35 Central Entry Office/Supplemental Insurance Fee ($35 total).
STK CONT.: Various
